convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'TSI_DeMarker' custom indicator and depends on two external .mqh libraries (TradeAlgorithms.mqh, SmoothAlgorithms.mqh) for trading logic and smoothing algorithms. Position sizing uses custom MarginMode enum from external library.

indicators.name: TSI_DeMarker
indicators.derived_period: DeMarkerPeriod + MomPeriod + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength1,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength2,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength3,XPhase) + 3 + SignalBar

derived_values.name: TimeShiftSec - seconds per bar of indicator timeframe
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator warm-up
derived_values.formula: DeMarkerPeriod + MomPeriod + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength1,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength2,XPhase) + GetStartBars(XMA_Method,XLength3,XPhase) + 3 + SignalBar

other_exits: Buy closed when indicator crosses below signal line (Ind[1]<Sign[1]) if BuyPosClose enabled
Sell closed when indicator crosses above signal line (Ind[1]>Sign[1]) if SellPosClose enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum: LOT=fixed lots, FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM=0.1 with MMMode=LOT means 0.1 lot fixed; other modes interpret MM as percentage fraction.

custom_logic_notes: Entry signal uses previous bar (SignalBar=1 default) comparing bar[1] vs bar[2] of indicator buffers: long entry when Ind[1]>Sign[1] (prev-prev bar indicator above signal) AND Ind[0]<=Sign[0] (prev bar indicator crossed below or equal to signal on the earlier bar). This is a reversal-from-extreme pattern: buy when indicator was above signal but crossed down on the signal bar, sell when indicator was below signal but crossed up on the signal bar. The crossover detection uses 2-buffer copy starting at SignalBar offset, where Ind[0] is bar at SignalBar and Ind[1] is bar at SignalBar+1. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean input gates allowing independent enable/disable of each direction and action. SignalBar=0 allows intrabar (every tick) signal recalculation. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime passed to trade functions likely used for trade validation/timeout in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.
python_conversion_notes: Custom indicator TSI_DeMarker must be reimplemented in Python using the SmoothAlgorithms from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA smoothing methods). The TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose which handle money management (5 modes via MarginMode enum), SL/TP placement, and deviation control. These must be reimplemented. The GetStartBars() function from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh returns warm-up periods for each smoothing method. Signal logic compares two bars of indicator buffers: Ind[1]>Sign[1] with Ind[0]<=Sign[0] for buy (crossover detection with a 1-bar lag using SignalBar). Note: SL/TP values of 1000/2000 are in points (not pips), so for 5-digit brokers these are 100/200 pips respectively - no digit adjustment multiplier in code, values are used as-is with the broker's point size.
